whoFor: Non-profits, foundations, associations, schools and faith organisations registering as incorporated trustees with the CAC.

benefits.title: A sound constitution
benefits.text: Objects and governance rules that fit how you will actually run.

benefits.title: Trustees properly recorded
benefits.text: Trustee details, consents and documents complete before filing.

benefits.title: Ready for donors
benefits.text: The registration records funders usually ask to see.

whatYouReceive: Guidance on the trustee structure and objects
Preparation of the constitution and the CAC application
Submission and follow-up until the CAC responds, then your registration documents
whatYouProvide: Details and identification for each trustee
Minutes or resolutions appointing the trustees, if you have them
Your written authority for SCS to file on your behalf
doesNotInclude: A promise of when the CAC will process the application, or of its decision
Tax exemption applications, which are scoped separately
